note: Base recipe for videos (task 21b): the app cuts the video into shots locally and keeps one keyframe per shot; the model fills each shot's columns from its keyframe, names the hook of the first 30 seconds, and lists what the comments keep asking for.

prompt.zh:
你在把一条短视频拆成镜头表，给要照着翻拍的人用。镜头已经按画面切好，每个镜头给了编号、起止时间和一张关键帧（画面中间那一刻）。
- shot：每个镜头一行，shot 填镜头编号。visual：画面里发生了什么，一句话；line：这一镜说的话或字幕。镜头后面附了「语音」的，写全这段语音（机器转写，可能有读音相近的错字：对照画面字幕、标题、简介和常用语改正；关键帧只截了一瞬，画面上那句字幕只是其中一句，不要只抄那一句；几镜合起来转写的，按画面把句子分到各镜）；没附语音的抄画面字幕；都没有留空；size：景别（远景 / 全景 / 中景 / 近景 / 特写）；role：这一镜的作用（钩子 / 铺垫 / 冲突 / 反转 / 共情 / 引出商品 / 促单 / 结尾留悬念，挑最贴的一个）；must：翻拍时必须出现的东西（道具、商品、动作），没有就留空。
- hook：前 30 秒里留住人的钩子，1~3 条。shot 填它出现的镜头编号；what：钩子是什么；why：为什么留得住人。
- ask：评论里反复出现的需求（要链接、要全集、问在哪看、问用什么做的…），最多 5 条。quote：从某条评论原样摘一句；what：大家在要什么；count：大约几条评论在要。没给评论就不写 ask。
只写看得到、读得到的，不编。
只回 JSON，不要别的：{"parts":[{"type":"shot","shot":1,"visual":"…","line":"…","size":"近景","role":"钩子","must":"…"},{"type":"hook","shot":1,"what":"…","why":"…"},{"type":"ask","quote":"…","what":"…","count":"约 10 条"}]}
prompt.en:
You are turning a short video into a shot list for someone who will remake it. The video is already cut into shots; each has a number, start and end time and one keyframe (its middle moment).
- shot: one row per shot; shot is the shot number. visual: what happens on screen, one sentence; line: what is said in the shot, or its caption. If the shot carries "speech", write out all of it (a machine transcript that may contain similar-sounding mistakes: fix them using the on-screen caption, title, description and glossary; the keyframe is a single moment, so its caption is only one of the sentences, do not copy just that one; speech covering several shots: split the sentences across them by what you see); without speech, copy the on-screen caption; empty if none; size: framing (wide / full / medium / close-up / extreme close-up); role: the shot's purpose (hook / setup / conflict / twist / empathy / product reveal / call to buy / cliffhanger, pick the closest one); must: what a remake must show (prop, product, action), empty if nothing.
- hook: what keeps people watching in the first 30 seconds, 1-3 of them. shot: the shot it appears in; what: the hook; why: why it holds people.
- ask: what the comments keep asking for (a link, the full series, where to watch, what tool made it…), at most 5. quote: one sentence copied verbatim from a comment; what: what people want; count: roughly how many comments ask. No comments given, no asks.
Only write what can be seen or read; do not invent.
Reply with JSON only: {"parts":[{"type":"shot","shot":1,"visual":"…","line":"…","size":"close-up","role":"hook","must":"…"},{"type":"hook","shot":1,"what":"…","why":"…"},{"type":"ask","quote":"…","what":"…","count":"about 10"}]}
